hints.title: Extract One Indices
hints.text: Collect the indices of all ones into an array pos.

hints.title: Transform to Median Problem
hints.text: Define p[i] = pos[i] - i. Gathering k ones consecutively corresponds to minimizing distance to a median point.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Sliding Window
hints.text: Slide a window of length k over p and compute absolute deviation from median in constant time via prefix sums.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minMoves(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        p = [pos - i for i, pos in enumerate(i for i, x in enumerate(nums) if x == 1)]
        m = len(p)
        pref = [0] * (m + 1)
        for i in range(m):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + p[i]
        ans = float('inf')
        radius = (k - 1) // 2
        for i in range(m - k + 1):
            mid = i + k // 2
            left_cost = p[mid] * (mid - i) - (pref[mid] - pref[i])
            right_cost = (pref[i + k] - pref[mid + 1]) - p[mid] * (i + k - 1 - mid)
            ans = min(ans, left_cost + right_cost)
        return ans
```

variables: m is count of ones in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every window and calculating distance without prefix sums takes O(m * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sums over coordinate-shifted indices reduce window evaluation from O(k) to O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate maps adjacent swaps to median alignment problem using index transformation p[i] = pos[i] - i.

solutions.approach: Index shift transformation with median prefix sums
